query:
UPDATE repository_import
        SET state = $3,
            last_error = $4,
            finished_at = now(),
            updated_at = now(),
            run_id = NULL,
            locked_until = NULL,
            cancel_requested = false,
            password_enc = CASE WHEN $3 = 'completed' THEN NULL ELSE password_enc END
        WHERE id = $1 AND run_id = $2 AND state = 'running'
